verses.ar: وَبَعْدُ فَأَقُولُ: هُوَ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَاسْمُهُ شَيْبَةُ الْحَمْدِ حُمِدَتْ خِصَالُهُ السَّنِيَّةْ ۞ ابْنِ هَاشِمٍ وَاسْمُهُ عَمْرٌو ابْنِ عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ وَاسْمُهُ الْمُغِيرَةُ الَّذِي يَنْتَمِي الِارْتِقَاءُ لِعُلْيَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-baʿdu fa-aqūlu: huwa sayyidunā Muḥammadu bnu ʿAbdi Llāhi-bni ʿAbdi l-Muṭṭalibi wa-smuhu Shaybatu l-Ḥamdi ḥumidat khiṣāluhu s-saniyyah, ibni Hāshimin, wa-smuhu ʿAmrun ibni ʿAbdi Manāfin wa-smuhu l-Mughīratu lladhī yantami l-irtiqā'u li-ʿulyāh.
verses.en: Thereafter, I say: He is our master Muhammad, son of Abd Allah, son of Abd al-Muttalib, whose name was Shaybat al-Hamd and whose noble qualities were praised, son of Hashim, whose name was Amr, son of Abd Manaf, whose name was al-Mughirah, to whose lofty rank all heights aspire.

verses.ar: ابْنِ قُصَيٍّ وَاسْمُهُ مُجَمِّعٌ سُمِّيَ بِقُصَيٍّ لِتَقَاصِيهِ فِي بِلَادِ قُضَاعَةَ الْقَصِيَّةْ ۞ إِلَى أَنْ أَعَادَهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى إِلَى الْحَرَمِ الْمُحْتَرَمِ فَحَمَى حِمَاهْ ۞ ابْنِ كِلَابٍ وَاسْمُهُ حَكِيمٌ ابْنِ مُرَّةَ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ لُؤَيِّ بْنِ غَالِبِ بْنِ فِهْرٍ وَاسْمُهُ قُرَيْشٌ وَإِلَيْهِ تُنْسَبُ الْبُطُونُ الْقُرَشِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Ibni Quṣayyin wa-smuhu Mujammiʿun summiya bi-Quṣayyin li-taqāṣīhi fī bilādi Quḍāʿata l-qaṣiyyah, ilā an aʿādahu Llāhu taʿālā ilā l-ḥarami l-muḥtarami fa-ḥamā ḥimāh, ibni Kilābin wa-smuhu Ḥakīmun ibni Murrata-bni Kaʿbi-bni Lu'ayyi-bni Ghālibi-bni Fihrin wa-smuhu Qurayshun wa-ilayhi tunsabu l-buṭūnu l-Qurashiyyah.
verses.en: He is the son of Qusayy, whose name was Mujammi, and he was called Qusayy because of his being far away in the distant lands of Quda'ah, until Allah Most High returned him to the Sacred Sanctuary, where he protected its precincts. He is the son of Kilab, whose name was Hakim, son of Murrah, son of Kab, son of Luayy, son of Ghalib, son of Fihr, whose name was Quraysh, to whom the Qurashite clans trace their lineage.

verses.ar: وَمَا فَوْقَهُ كِنَانِيٌّ كَمَا جَنَحَ إِلَيْهِ الْكَثِيرُ وَارْتَضَاهْ ۞ ابْنِ مَالِكِ بْنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ كِنَانَةَ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ بْنِ مُدْرِكَةَ بْنِ إِلْيَاسَ وَهُوَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ أَهْدَى الْبُدْنَ إِلَى الرِّحَابِ الْحَرَمِيَّةْ ۞ وَسُمِعَ فِي صُلْبِهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَكَرَ اللّٰهَ تَعَالَى وَلَبَّاهْ ۞ ابْنِ مُضَرَ بْنِ نِزَارِ بْنِ مَعَدِّ بْنِ عَدْنَانَ ۞ وَهَذَا سِلْكٌ نَظَمَتْ فَرَائِدَهُ بَنَانُ السُّنَّةِ السَّنِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-mā fawqahu Kināniyyun kamā janaḥa ilayhi l-kathīru wa-rtaḍāh, ibni Māliki-bni n-Naḍri-bni Kinānata-bni Khuzaymata-bni Mudrikata-bni Ilyāsa wa-huwa awwalu man ahda l-budna ilā r-riḥābi l-ḥaramiyyah, wa-sumiʿa fī ṣulbihi n-nabiyyu ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama dhakara Llāha taʿālā wa-labbāh, ibni Muḍara-bni Nizāri-bni Maʿaddi-bni ʿAdnāna wa-hādhā silkun naẓamat farā'idahu banānu s-sunnati s-saniyyah.
verses.en: Those above him are of Kinanah, according to the view favoured and accepted by many. He is the son of Malik, son of al-Nadr, son of Kinanah, son of Khuzaymah, son of Mudrikah, son of Ilyas, who was the first to offer sacrificial camels in the Sacred Precinct. From his loins, the Prophet, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, was heard remembering Allah Most High and answering His call. He is the son of Mudar, son of Nizar, son of Maadd, son of Adnan. This is a strand whose precious pearls were threaded by the fingers of the exalted Sunnah.

verses.ar: وَرَفْعُهُ إِلَى الْخَلِيلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَمْسَكَ عَنْهُ الشَّارِعُ وَأَبَاهْ ۞ وَعَدْنَانُ بِلَا رَيْبٍ عِنْدَ ذَوِي الْعُلُومِ النَّسَبِيَّةْ ۞ إِلَى الذَّبِيحِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ نِسْبَتُهُ وَمُنْتَمَاهُ وَمُنْتَهَاهْ ۞ فَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ مِنْ عِقْدٍ تَأَلَّقَتْ كَوَاكِبُهُ الدُّرِّيَّةْ ۞ وَكَيْفَ لَا وَالسَّيِّدُ الْأَكْرَمُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَاسِطَتُهُ الْمُنْتَقَاةْ
verses.tr: Wa-rafʿuhu ilā l-khalīli Ibrāhīma ʿalayhi s-salāmu amsaka ʿanhu sh-shāriʿu wa-abāh, wa-ʿAdnānu bilā raybin ʿinda dhawī l-ʿulūmi n-nasabiyyah, ilā dh-dhabīḥi Ismāʿīla nisbatuhu wa-muntamāhu wa-muntahāh fa-aʿẓim bihi min ʿiqdin ta'allaqat kawākibuhu d-durriyyah, wa-kayfa lā wa-s-sayyidu l-akramu ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama wāsiṭatuhu l-muntaqāh.
verses.en: As for tracing the lineage back to the Friend of Allah, Ibrahim, peace be upon him, the Lawgiver refrained from doing so and declined it. Yet there is no doubt among the scholars of genealogy that Adnan's lineage, ancestry, and ultimate descent reach back to Ismail, the one offered for sacrifice. How magnificent is this necklace, whose radiant stars shine brilliantly. And how could it be otherwise, when the Most Noble Master, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, is its chosen central jewel?

verses.ar: نَسَبٌ تَحْسَبُ الْعُلَا بِحُلَاهُ ۞ قَلَّدَتْهَا نُجُومَهَا الْجَوْزَاءُ ۞ حَبَّذَا عِقْدُ سُؤْدَدٍ وَفَخَارٍ ۞ أَنْتَ فِيهِ الْيَتِيمَةُ الْعَصْمَاءُ ۞ أَكْرِمْ بِهِ مِنْ نَسَبٍ طَهَّرَهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى مِنْ سِفَاحِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةْ ۞ أَوْرَدَ الزَّيْنُ الْعِرَاقِيُّ وَارِدَهُ فِي مَوْرِدِهِ الْهَنِيِّ وَرَوَاهْ
verses.tr: Nasabun taḥsabu l-ʿulā bi-ḥulāhu, qalladat-hā nujūmaha l-jawzā'u, ḥabbadhā ʿiqdu su'dadin wa-fakhārin, anta fīhi l-yatīmatu l-ʿaṣmā'u, akrim bihi min nasabin ṭahharahu Llāhu taʿālā min sifāḥi l-jāhiliyyah, awrada z-Zaynu l-ʿIrāqiyyu wāridahu fī mawridihi l-haniyyi wa-rawāh.
verses.en: A lineage whose ornaments make you think that Orion has adorned the heights of glory with its stars. How splendid is this necklace of nobility and honour, in which you are the peerless and flawless pearl. How noble is this lineage, which Allah Most High purified from the unlawful unions of the Age of Ignorance. Zayn al-Iraqi cited and narrated this account in his delightful work.

verses.ar: حَفِظَ الْإِلَهُ كَرَامَةً لِمُحَمَّدٍ ۞ آبَاءَهُ الْأَمْجَادَ صَوْنًا لِاسْمِهِ ۞ تَرَكُوا السِّفَاحَ فَلَمْ يُصِبْهُمْ عَارُهُ ۞ مِنْ آدَمَ وَإِلَى أَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ ۞ سَرَاةٌ سَرَى نُورُ النُّبُوَّةِ فِي أَسَارِيرِ غُرَرِهِمُ الْبَهِيَّةْ ۞ وَبَدَرَ بَدْرُهُ فِي جَبِينِ جَدِّهِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَابْنِهِ عَبْدِ اللّٰهْ
verses.tr: Ḥafiẓa l-Ilāhu karāmatan li-Muḥammadin, ābā'ahu l-amjāda ṣawnan li-smihi, taraku s-sifāḥa fa-lam yuṣibhum ʿāruhu, min Ādama wa-ilā abīhi wa-ummihi, sarātun sarā nūru n-nubuwwati fī asārīri ghurarihimu l-bahiyyah, wa-badara badruhu fī jabīni jaddihi ʿAbdi l-Muṭṭalibi wa-bnihi ʿAbdi Llāh.
verses.en: Allah, in honour of Muhammad, safeguarded his noble forefathers, preserving them for the sake of his name. They abstained from unlawful unions, and no shame from them touched his lineage, from Adam down to his father and mother. They were noble men through whose radiant countenances the light of Prophethood passed, and its full moon shone forth upon the brow of his grandfather Abd al-Muttalib and his son Abd Allah.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
